title: Our Wordmark
slide_intent: Show how the lettering draws from the same shapes as the mark so a designer can recognize a family resemblance.
strategic_value: Repeating the carrot’s curves and joins in the letters can tie the name, symbol and typeface together.
demonstration: Blue construction notes overlay a pale wordmark. They identify circular curves, rounded counters and joints in individual letters.
practical_value: Compare letter details with the mark when assessing whether new lettering belongs to the system.

content_islands.name: Origin note
content_islands.spec: Set the wordmark heading and its explanation at the left.

content_islands.name: Letter construction
content_islands.spec: Place a pale large signature across the center-right. Draw blue guides and captions against individual letter details and the adjacent symbol.
